newsitem.title: UK: BA rebounds after positive press comment.
newsitem.headline: BA rebounds after positive press comment.

text.p: Shares in British Airways Plc rose on Tuesday, recovering from Monday's decline amid positive press comment following its first-quarter results.
The stock was up 24p at 634 by 0816 GMT in volume of 2.2 million shares.
The Financial Times' influential Lex column said BA's greater-than-expected strike costs of 125 million stg did not remotely justify Monday's 30p decline in its shares.

Lex said BA shares had underperformed the UK equity market by 20 percent since the middle of May, leaving them on an attractive discount of between 10 and 20 percent on the basis of expected earnings for 1998.
